<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="th">

<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Brain MRI T1W Anatomy Learning Platform</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #000000;
      --card-bg: #111318;
      --card-bg-2: #16181f;
      --border: #26282f;
      --primary: #22d3ee;
      --primary-dark: #0891b2;
      --text: #e5e7eb;
      --muted: #9ca3af;
      --danger: #f87171;
      --success: #4ade80;
      --radius: 10px;
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      font-family: "Segoe UI", "Chulabhorn Likit Text Light", sans-serif;
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
    }

    a {
      color: var(--primary);
    }

    .navbar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      background: var(--card-bg);
      padding: 12px 24px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 10;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .brand {
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      color: var(--primary);
    }

    #nav-menu a {
      margin: 0 4px;
      text-decoration: none;
      color: var(--text);
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      padding: 6px 10px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    #nav-menu a:hover,
    #nav-menu a.active {
      background: var(--primary);
      color: #00161a;
    }

    #app {
      max-width: 1150px;
      margin: 24px auto;
      padding: 0 16px;
    }

    .card {
      background: var(--card-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 20px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    button,
    .btn {
      background: var(--primary);
      color: #00161a;
      border: none;
      padding: 10px 18px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    button:hover {
      background: var(--primary-dark);
      color: white;
    }

    button.secondary {
      background: #232630;
      color: var(--text);
    }

    button.secondary:hover {
      background: #2c2f3a;
    }

    button.danger {
      background: var(--danger);
      color: #1a0000;
    }

    button:disabled {
      opacity: 0.5;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    input,
    select,
    textarea {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 10px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      background: #0b0c10;
      color: var(--text);
    }

    .grid {
      display: grid;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .grid-2 {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    }

    .grid-3 {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    }

    @media (max-width: 700px) {

      .grid-2,
      .grid-3 {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    .compare-images {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .compare-images .img-box {
      position: relative;
      max-width: 460px;
    }

    .compare-images img {
      width: 100%;
      border-radius: 8px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      display: block;
      background: #000;
    }

    .hotspot {
      position: absolute;
      width: 12px;
      height: 12px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.9);
      border: none;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      cursor: pointer;
      box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.8);
    }

    .hotspot:hover {
      background: rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.95);
    }

    .tag {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 3px 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: #0e2a30;
      color: var(--primary);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      margin-right: 6px;
      border: 1px solid var(--primary-dark);
    }

    .timer {
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--danger);
      font-size: 1.2rem;
    }

    .flashcard {
      perspective: 1000px;
      height: 200px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .flashcard-inner {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      transition: transform 0.5s;
      transform-style: preserve-3d;
    }

    .flashcard.flipped .flashcard-inner {
      transform: rotateY(180deg);
    }

    .flashcard-front,
    .flashcard-back {
      position: absolute;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      backface-visibility: hidden;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .flashcard-front {
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, #0e2a30, #0b0c10);
      color: var(--primary);
    }

    .flashcard-back {
      background: #16181f;
      color: var(--text);
      transform: rotateY(180deg);
    }

    .progress-bar-bg {
      background: #1c1e26;
      border-radius: 999px;
      height: 10px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .progress-bar-fill {
      background: var(--success);
      height: 100%;
    }

    table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
    }

    th,
    td {
      padding: 8px 10px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      text-align: left;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .muted {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
    }

    .error {
      color: var(--danger);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .success {
      color: var(--success);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    label.opt {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .lang-toggle {
      display: flex;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .lang-toggle button {
      padding: 6px 12px;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      background: #0b0c10;
      color: var(--muted);
      border-radius: 0;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .lang-toggle button.active {
      background: var(--primary);
      color: #00161a;
    }

    /* ---- MRI Viewer ---- */
    .viewer-wrap {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .viewer-stage {
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 320px;
      background: #000;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      position: relative;
      min-height: 420px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .viewer-stage img {
      max-width: 100%;
      max-height: 520px;
      user-select: none;
    }

    .viewer-side {
      width: 260px;
    }

    .plane-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .plane-tabs button {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 8px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
    }

    .plane-tabs button.secondary {
      background: #0b0c10;
    }

    .slice-controls {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 10px;
    }

    .slice-controls input[type=range] {
      flex: 1;
      margin: 0;
      accent-color: var(--primary);
    }

    .slice-readout {
      text-align: center;
      margin-top: 8px;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      color: var(--primary);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .viewer-note {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-top: 14px;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .checkbox-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin: 10px 0;
    }

    .checkbox-row input {
      width: auto;
      margin: 0;
    }

    /* ===================== REDESIGNED BRAIN LEARNING WINDOWS ===================== */
    :root {
      --gold: #e4b84f;
      --gold-2: #f4cf72;
      --panel: #111217;
      --panel2: #19191f;
      --line: #2c2d35;
      --purple: #6d4aff;
      --soft: #a6a7b1;
    }

    body {
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 10% 0%, #161427 0, #07080d 38%, #000 78%);
    }

    .navbar {
      max-width: 1180px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      background: rgba(34, 34, 37, .96);
      padding: 10px 18px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #3a3a42;
    }

    #nav-menu {
      display: flex;
      gap: 2px;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap
    }

    #nav-menu a {
      margin: 0;
      color: #d8d8dd;
      padding: 10px 8px;
      border-radius: 0;
      font-weight: 650;
      font-size: .82rem
    }

    #nav-menu a:hover,
    #nav-menu a.active {
      background: transparent;
      color: white;
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--gold)
    }

    .brand {
      color: #f5f5f5
    }

    .brand span {
      color: #f0a24b
    }

    #app {
      max-width: 1180px;
      margin: 18px auto 34px;
      padding: 0 18px
    }

    .ref-window {
      background: #030407;
      border: 1px solid #242630;
      border-radius: 22px;
      padding: 20px;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, .02), 0 18px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, .45)
    }

    .ref-top {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 14px
    }

    .ref-title {
      font-size: 1.28rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      margin: 0
    }

    .ref-sub {
      color: var(--soft);
      font-size: .82rem;
      margin: 4px 0 0
    }

    .ref-pill {
      border: 1px solid #363741;
      background: #14151b;
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 7px 12px;
      color: #d7d8de;
      font-size: .78rem
    }

    .window-grid {
      display: grid;
      gap: 16px
    }

    .viewer-window {
      grid-template-columns: 150px minmax(0, 1fr) 260px
    }

    .side-panel {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #15161d, #0b0c11);
      border: 1px solid #292b35;
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 14px
    }

    .side-panel h4 {
      margin: 0 0 12px;
      font-size: .8rem;
      color: #c7c8cf;
      letter-spacing: .08em
    }

    .mini-preview {
      border: 1px solid #292b35;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 5px;
      background: #07080b;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      position: relative
    }

    .mini-preview img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 64px;
      object-fit: contain;
      display: block;
      border-radius: 6px;
      filter: grayscale(1);
      background: #000
    }

    .mini-preview.square-plane img {
      aspect-ratio: 1/1;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain
    }

    .viewer-main.plane-square>div[style*="position:relative"] {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 0
    }

    .viewer-main.plane-square #viewer-img {
      width: min(100%, 560px);
      height: auto;
      aspect-ratio: 1/1;
      object-fit: contain;
      margin: auto
    }

    .mini-preview.active {
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--gold)
    }

    .atlas-tools {
      display: flex;
      gap: 7px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin: 10px 0
    }

    .atlas-tools button {
      font-size: .72rem
    }

    .atlas-search {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      margin: 8px 0
    }

    .atlas-search input {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 8px
    }

    .crossref {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 10px
    }

    .crossref-card {
      border: 1px solid #292b35;
      border-radius: 9px;
      background: #08090d;
      padding: 5px;
      cursor: pointer
    }

    .crossref-card img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 76px;
      object-fit: contain;
      background: #000;
      border-radius: 6px;
      display: block
    }

    .crossref-card.active {
      border-color: var(--gold);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--gold)
    }

    .orientation {
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px;
      left: 16px;
      right: 16px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      pointer-events: none;
      color: #c9cad1;
      font-size: .65rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-shadow: 0 1px 4px #000
    }

    .orientation span {
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .55);
      padding: 3px 6px;
      border-radius: 5px
    }

    .viewer-main.is-zoomed #viewer-img {
      transform: scale(1.35);
      cursor: grab
    }

    .viewer-main.is-zoomed #viewer-img:active {
      cursor: grabbing
    }

    .label-search-result {
      font-size: .72rem;
      color: #c9cad1;
      padding: 5px 0
    }

    .label-search-result strong {
      color: #f0c75e
    }

    .viewer-help {
      font-size: .68rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
      color: #8e9099;
      margin-top: 8px
    }

    .viewer-main {
      min-width: 0;
      background: #020304;
      border: 1px solid #292b35;
      border-radius: 18px;
      padding: 10px;
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column
    }

    .viewer-main img {
      width: 100%;
      height: min(62vh, 560px);
      object-fit: contain;
      background: #000;
      border-radius: 12px;
      display: block
    }

    .viewer-toolbar {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-top: 10px
    }

    .slice-strip {
      display: flex;
      gap: 5px;
      overflow: auto;
      padding: 8px 2px
    }

    .slice-thumb {
      flex: 0 0 42px;
      height: 42px;
      border: 1px solid #2c2e37;
      border-radius: 7px;
      padding: 1px;
      background: #08090c;
      cursor: pointer
    }

    .slice-thumb img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      border-radius: 5px;
      filter: grayscale(1)
    }

    .slice-thumb.active {
      border-color: var(--gold);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--gold)
    }

    .control-btn {
      background: #17181f;
      color: #e7e7ea;
      border: 1px solid #353640;
      padding: 7px 10px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-size: .75rem
    }

    .control-btn.active,
    .gold-btn {
      background: #c28a10;
      color: #fff;
      border-color: #d7a634
    }

    .legend-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin: 10px 0;
      font-size: .78rem;
      color: #d7d7dc
    }

    .legend-swatch {
      width: 18px;
      height: 10px;
      border-radius: 8px
    }

    .label-list {
      max-height: 280px;
      overflow: auto;
      padding-right: 3px
    }

    .label-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 9px 2px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #24252d;
      font-size: .78rem
    }

    .label-dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--gold)
    }

    .plane-switch {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-bottom: 10px
    }

    .plane-switch button {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 8px 5px;
      background: #111218;
      color: #c9cad1;
      border: 1px solid #31323b;
      border-radius: 7px;
      font-size: .7rem
    }

    .plane-switch button.active {
      background: #272018;
      border-color: #c9962d;
      color: #fff
    }

    .flash-window {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 175px minmax(240px, 1fr) minmax(240px, 1fr) 210px;
      gap: 22px;
      align-items: stretch
    }

    .category-list {
      max-height: 420px;
      overflow: auto
    }

    .category-btn {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      text-align: left;
      background: transparent;
      color: #c4c5cc;
      border: 0;
      padding: 10px 4px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #24252d;
      font-size: .78rem
    }

    .category-btn.active {
      color: #fff;
      border-left: 3px solid var(--gold);
      padding-left: 10px
    }

    .study-card {
      min-height: 390px;
      border: 1px solid #30313a;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: #08090d;
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
      box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255, 255, 255, .05) inset;
      cursor: pointer
    }

    .study-card .count {
      position: absolute;
      right: 14px;
      top: 12px;
      background: #15161d;
      padding: 5px 8px;
      border-radius: 7px;
      color: #a9abb3;
      font-size: .68rem;
      z-index: 2
    }

    .study-image {
      height: 100%;
      min-height: 390px;
      background: #000;
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center
    }

    .study-image img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: contain
    }

    .study-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, .05), rgba(0, 0, 0, .68));
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      padding: 24px
    }

    .study-overlay h2 {
      font-size: 1.3rem;
      margin: 0;
      color: white;
      line-height: 1.35
    }

    .study-info {
      padding: 24px;
      min-height: 390px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center
    }

    .study-info h2 {
      margin: 0 0 8px;
      font-size: 1.45rem;
      color: #fff
    }

    .study-info .meaning {
      color: var(--gold-2);
      font-size: 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 18px
    }

    .study-info p {
      font-size: .82rem;
      line-height: 1.65;
      color: #c4c5cc
    }

    .study-info ul {
      font-size: .76rem;
      color: #b4b5bd;
      padding-left: 18px
    }

    .body-map {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 260px;
      border: 1px solid #2a2b34;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, #24232d 0, #0b0c11 65%)
    }

    .body-map .brain-orb {
      font-size: 6rem;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 18px rgba(228, 184, 79, .25))
    }

    .review-bar {
      grid-column: 1/-1;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 8px;
      background: #242428;
      border: 1px solid #5d5d61;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 9px 16px;
      color: #e4e4e8;
      font-size: .78rem
    }

    .quiz-window {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 170px minmax(230px, .85fr) minmax(300px, 1.1fr) 230px;
      gap: 20px;
      align-items: stretch
    }

    .profile-box {
      padding: 14px;
      background: #15161d;
      border: 1px solid #2a2b34;
      border-radius: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      font-size: .78rem
    }

    .profile-box b {
      display: block;
      font-size: .9rem;
      margin-bottom: 4px
    }

    .filter-select {
      background: #0d0e13;
      color: #e6e6e9;
      border: 1px solid #343540;
      border-radius: 9px;
      padding: 10px;
      width: 100%;
      margin: 6px 0 12px
    }

    .quiz-image {
      border: 1px solid #2e3038;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: #050607;
      min-height: 410px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
      overflow: hidden
    }

    .quiz-image img {
      width: 100%;
      max-height: 360px;
      object-fit: contain;
      background: #000
    }

    .quiz-image .img-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 10px
    }

    .question-card {
      border: 1px solid #353640;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #14151b, #0b0c10);
      padding: 24px;
      min-height: 410px
    }

    .question-card h2 {
      font-size: 1.18rem;
      line-height: 1.45;
      margin: 0 0 20px
    }

    .answer-option {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 12px 13px;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      border-radius: 10px;
      cursor: pointer;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      font-size: .85rem
    }

    .answer-option:hover {
      background: #15161d;
      border-color: #33343d
    }

    .answer-option.selected {
      border-color: var(--gold);
      background: #17140d
    }

    .answer-option.correct {
      border-color: #4ade80;
      background: #102218
    }

    .answer-option.wrong {
      border-color: #f87171;
      background: #2a1113
    }

    .answer-key {
      color: var(--gold);
      font-weight: 800;
      width: 20px
    }

    .quiz-status {
      margin-top: 16px;
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      font-weight: 800
    }

    .explanation-box {
      background: #0b0c11;
      border-left: 1px solid #24252d;
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      min-height: 410px
    }

    .explanation-box h4 {
      margin: 0 0 12px;
      color: #aeb0b8;
      font-size: .78rem
    }

    .explanation-box p {
      font-size: .84rem;
      line-height: 1.6;
      color: #d1d2d8
    }

    .lab-setup {
      max-width: 860px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 24px
    }

    .setup-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 18px
    }

    .choice-group {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap
    }

    .choice-chip {
      background: #101117;
      color: #d3d4da;
      border: 1px solid #343540;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: .8rem
    }

    .choice-chip.active {
      border-color: var(--gold);
      background: #241b09;
      color: #fff
    }

    .lab-exam-window {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 250px;
      gap: 16px
    }

    .exam-stage {
      background: #111217;
      border: 1px solid #4c421d;
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 12px;
      position: relative
    }

    .exam-stage img {
      width: 100%;
      max-height: 480px;
      object-fit: contain;
      background: #000;
      border-radius: 10px
    }

    .exam-pin {
      position: absolute;
      width: 15px;
      height: 15px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #e72c0f;
      color: #fff;
      border: 1.5px solid #ffdd83;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-weight: 800;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      box-shadow: 0 0 06px rgba(214, 155, 16, .7)
    }

    .exam-side {
      background: #111217;
      border: 1px solid #312c1b;
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 16px
    }

    .timer-big {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: #f18023;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: .04em
    }

    .station-strip {
      display: flex;
      gap: 7px;
      margin-top: 10px;
      flex-wrap: wrap
    }

    .station {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: #25262d;
      border: 1px solid #3b3c45;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: .76rem
    }

    .station.active {
      background: #4b3a0a;
      border-color: #d7a634;
      color: #fff
    }

    .practice-badge {
      display: inline-block;
      background: #143022;
      color: #83e7aa;
      border: 1px solid #2c6b46;
      padding: 5px 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-size: .72rem
    }

    .exam-vertical {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
      max-width: 760px;
      margin: 0 auto
    }

    .exam-header-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px
    }

    .exam-question-card {
      background: #111217;
      border: 1px solid #4c421d;
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 16px 18px
    }

    .exam-question-card h4 {
      margin: 0 0 8px;
      font-size: .76rem;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      color: #e4b84f
    }

    .exam-question-card p {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 1.04rem;
      line-height: 1.6;
      color: #f1f1f4
    }

    .exam-image-card {
      background: #111217;
      border: 1px solid #4c421d;
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 12px;
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center
    }

    .exam-image-card img {
      max-width: 520px;
      width: 100%;
      max-height: 440px;
      object-fit: contain;
      background: #000;
      border-radius: 10px;
      display: block
    }

    .exam-answer-card {
      background: #111217;
      border: 1px solid #4c421d;
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 16px 18px
    }

    .exam-answer-card h4 {
      margin: 0 0 12px;
      font-size: .76rem;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      color: #c7c8cf
    }

    .exam-written-input {
      margin-bottom: 4px
    }

    .exam-divider-or {
      text-align: center;
      color: #8e9099;
      font-size: .72rem;
      margin: 6px 0 12px;
      letter-spacing: .1em
    }

    .exam-mcq-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 14px
    }

    @media(max-width:680px) {
      .exam-mcq-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr
      }
    }

    .exam-mcq-option {
      border: 1px solid #343640;
      background: #14151b;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 11px 13px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: .85rem;
      color: #e5e7eb;
      transition: border-color .15s, background .15s
    }

    .exam-mcq-option:hover {
      border-color: #e4b84f
    }

    .exam-mcq-option.selected {
      border-color: #e4b84f;
      background: #241d0c
    }

    .exam-mcq-option.correct {
      border-color: #4ade80;
      background: #0f2417;
      color: #8ef0b6
    }

    .exam-mcq-option.wrong {
      border-color: #f87171;
      background: #2a1414;
      color: #ffaaa9
    }

    /* ================= QUIZIZZ-STYLE FLASHCARD MODE ================= */
    .flash-window {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 210px minmax(0, 1fr) 245px;
      gap: 16px;
      align-items: stretch
    }

    .flash-quiz-shell {
      min-width: 0;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px
    }

    .flash-topbar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 12px;
      background: #111217;
      border: 1px solid #292b35;
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 10px 14px
    }

    .flash-progress {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      min-width: 0;
      flex: 1
    }

    .flash-progress-track {
      height: 8px;
      background: #292b35;
      border-radius: 99px;
      overflow: hidden;
      flex: 1;
      max-width: 420px
    }

    .flash-progress-fill {
      height: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #6d4aff, #e4b84f);
      border-radius: 99px;
      transition: width .25s ease
    }

    .flash-stat {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 7px;
      background: #1a1b22;
      border: 1px solid #30313b;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 7px 10px;
      font-size: .74rem;
      color: #e9e9ee;
      white-space: nowrap
    }

    .flash-stat .stat-value {
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #ecba3c
    }

    .flash-question-card {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 520px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      border: 2px solid #353640;
      background: linear-gradient(145deg, #171821, #08090d);
      padding: 12px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 14px 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, .38)
    }

    .flash-question-card:hover {
      border-color: #2f55e9
    }

    .flash-card-inner {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      min-height: 496px;
      perspective: 1200px
    }

    .flash-card-face {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      border-radius: 18px;
      backface-visibility: hidden;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: transform .48s cubic-bezier(.2, .75, .25, 1), opacity .2s ease
    }

    .flash-question-card.swiping {
      cursor: grabbing
    }

    .flash-question-card.swiping .flash-card-inner {
      transition: none
    }

    .flash-swipe-hint {
      position: absolute;
      top: 14px;
      right: 14px;
      z-index: 4;
      background: rgba(17, 18, 23, .88);
      border: 1px solid #454651;
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 6px 10px;
      font-size: .68rem;
      color: #ddd;
      pointer-events: none
    }

    .flash-swipe-hint b {
      color: #ebab3c
    }

    .flash-card-front-face {
      background: #050608
    }

    .flash-card-back-face {
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 25%, #262032 0, #111219 55%, #08090d 100%);
      transform: rotateY(180deg);
      padding: 30px;
      text-align: center
    }

    .flash-question-card.flipped .flash-card-front-face {
      transform: rotateY(180deg)
    }

    .flash-question-card.flipped .flash-card-back-face {
      transform: rotateY(360deg)
    }

    .flash-image-wrap {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: #000
    }

    .flash-image-wrap img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: contain
    }

    .flash-image-badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: 14px;
      left: 14px;
      background: rgba(17, 18, 23, .88);
      border: 1px solid #454651;
      border-radius: 9px;
      padding: 7px 10px;
      font-size: .7rem;
      color: #ddd;
      z-index: 2
    }

    .flash-identify {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      padding: 38px 20px 20px;
      background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0, 0, 0, .9));
      text-align: center
    }

    .flash-identify strong {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      color: #fff
    }

    .flash-identify span {
      display: block;
      font-size: .72rem;
      color: #b9bbc4;
      margin-top: 5px
    }

    .flash-answer-icon {
      font-size: 3rem;
      margin-bottom: 8px
    }

    .flash-answer-label {
      font-size: .7rem;
      color: #aeb0ba;
      letter-spacing: .14em;
      font-weight: 800
    }

    .flash-answer-term {
      font-size: 2rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #f4cf72;
      margin: 8px 0 12px
    }

    .flash-answer-desc {
      max-width: 520px;
      color: #c7c8d0;
      font-size: .82rem;
      line-height: 1.65
    }

    .flash-actions {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 10px
    }

    .flash-action {
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      font-size: .8rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      border: 1px solid #343640;
      background: #14151b;
      color: #eee;
      cursor: pointer
    }

    .flash-action:hover {
      transform: translateY(-1px)
    }

    .flash-action.review {
      border-color: #a45a5a;
      background: #211215;
      color: #ffaaa9
    }

    .flash-action.know {
      border-color: #39785a;
      background: #102219;
      color: #8ef0b6
    }

    .flash-flip-hint {
      text-align: center;
      color: #8e9099;
      font-size: .7rem
    }

    .flash-right-panel {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px
    }

    .flash-deck-card {
      background: #111217;
      border: 1px solid #292b35;
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 14px
    }

    .flash-deck-card h4 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: #c7c8cf;
      font-size: .76rem;
      letter-spacing: .08em
    }

    .flash-topic {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 9px 10px;
      border-radius: 9px;
      background: #0b0c11;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      font-size: .74rem;
      color: #d7d8de;
      border: 1px solid transparent
    }

    .flash-topic.active {
      border-color: #6d4aff;
      background: #17132b;
      color: #fff
    }

    .flash-topic span:last-child {
      color: #a9aab3
    }

    .flash-mastery {
      height: 7px;
      background: #292b35;
      border-radius: 99px;
      overflow: hidden
    }

    .flash-mastery div {
      height: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #6d4aff, #e4b84f);
      border-radius: 99px
    }

    .flash-footer {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: #242428;
      border: 1px solid #55565d;
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 9px 12px
    }

    .flash-footer .control-btn {
      font-size: .75rem
    }

    .flash-counter {
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #f0f0f3;
      font-size: .75rem
    }

    /* ---- Flashcard position pointer + animated boundary outline ---- */
    .flash-marker-pin {
      position: absolute;
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 3
    }

    .flash-marker-pin::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(246, 75, 8, 0.95);
      border: 2px solid #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(228, 184, 79, .28), 0 0 10px rgba(250, 113, 54, 0.85)
    }

    .flash-marker-pin::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: -9px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 2px solid rgba(243, 158, 67, 0.85)
      animation: flashPinPulse 1.4s ease-out infinite
    }

    @keyframes flashPinPulse {
      0% {
        transform: scale(.5);
        opacity: .9
      }

      100% {
        transform: scale(1.9);
        opacity: 0
      }
    }

    .flash-boundary-svg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: visible;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 2
    }

    .flash-boundary-path {
      fill: rgba(109, 74, 255, .12);
      stroke: #fb8a00;
      stroke-width: 1.4;
      vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(228, 184, 79, .85))
    }

    @keyframes flashBoundaryDraw {
      to {
        stroke-dashoffset: 0
      }
    }

    .flash-answer-mini {
      position: relative;
      width: min(78%, 300px);
      aspect-ratio: 1/1;
      margin: 6px auto 14px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid #343640;
      background: #000;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 26px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4)
    }

    .flash-answer-mini img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: contain;
      display: block
    }

    .quiz-timer-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      background: #1a1b22;
      border: 1px solid #343640;
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 5px 12px;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: .85rem;
      color: var(--danger);
      float: right
    }

    .quiz-timer-badge.warn {
      animation: quizTimerWarn .6s ease-in-out infinite
    }

    @keyframes quizTimerWarn {

      0%,
      100% {
        background: #1a1b22
      }

      50% {
        background: #3a1414
      }
    }

    @media(max-width:1000px) {
      .flash-window {
        grid-template-columns: 180px minmax(0, 1fr)
      }

      .flash-right-panel {
        grid-column: 1/-1;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr
      }

      .flash-question-card {
        min-height: 480px
      }

      .flash-card-inner {
        min-height: 456px
      }
    }

    @media(max-width:680px) {
      .flash-window {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr
      }

      .flash-right-panel {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr
      }

      .flash-question-card {
        min-height: 390px
      }

      .flash-card-inner {
        min-height: 366px
      }

      .flash-answer-term {
        font-size: 1.5rem
      }

      .flash-topbar {
        flex-wrap: wrap
      }

      .flash-progress {
        width: 100%
      }
    }

    @media(max-width:1000px) {

      .viewer-window,
      .flash-window,
      .quiz-window {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr
      }

      .flash-window .review-bar,
      .quiz-window .explanation-box {
        grid-column: 1/-1
      }

      .body-map {
        min-height: 200px
      }

      .lab-exam-window {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr
      }
    }

    @media(max-width:680px) {
      .navbar {
        padding: 10px
      }

      .brand {
        width: 100%
      }

      #nav-menu {
        overflow: auto;
        flex-wrap: nowrap;
        width: 100%
      }

      .viewer-window,
      .flash-window,
      .quiz-window,
      .setup-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr
      }

      .side-panel {
        width: 100%
      }

      .study-card,
      .study-image {
        min-height: 300px
      }

      .review-bar {
        flex-wrap: wrap
      }

      .quiz-image,
      .question-card,
      .explanation-box {
        min-height: auto
      }
    }


    /* ===================== PROGRESS / DASHBOARD STYLE ===================== */
    .progress-page {
      max-width: 1180px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 10px 0 40px
    }

    .progress-hero-head {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: end;
      gap: 18px;
      margin: 4px 0 18px;
      padding: 0 4px
    }

    .progress-hero-head h1 {
      margin: 3px 0 5px;
      font-size: 2rem;
      letter-spacing: -.02em
    }

    .progress-hero-head p {
      margin: 0;
      color: #a6a7ad;
      font-size: .9rem
    }

    .progress-kicker {
      font-size: .68rem;
      letter-spacing: .16em;
      color: #e4b84f;
      font-weight: 800
    }

    .progress-report-btn {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #25262b, #111217);
      border: 1px solid #5a5134;
      color: #eee;
      padding: 11px 15px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(228, 184, 79, .08) inset
    }

    .progress-report-btn span,
    .mini-link span {
      color: #e4b84f;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      margin-left: 8px
    }

    .progress-top-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.02fr 1.25fr 1.02fr;
      gap: 14px
    }

    .progress-glass {
      background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(25, 26, 31, .96), rgba(10, 11, 14, .96));
      border: 1px solid #3a3a3d;
      border-radius: 12px;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, .28), inset 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, .04);
      overflow: hidden
    }

    .overall-panel,
    .analytics-panel,
    .performance-panel {
      min-height: 275px;
      padding: 16px
    }

    .panel-title {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      color: #e8e8e8;
      font-size: .72rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: .06em
    }

    .panel-menu {
      color: #777;
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      line-height: 1
    }

    .level-ring {
      width: 142px;
      height: 142px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      margin: 17px auto 13px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;

      background:radial-gradient(circle at center, #181a20 58%, transparent 59%),
      conic-gradient(#e4b84f 0 $ {
          levelPct
        }

        %, #3a3a3d $ {
          levelPct
        }

        % 100%);
      box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(228, 184, 79, .16)
    }

    .level-ring>div {
      width: 112px;
      height: 112px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: #15161b
    }

    .level-ring span {
      font-size: .72rem;
      color: #e4b84f
    }

    .level-ring strong {
      font-size: 2.35rem;
      line-height: 1;
      color: #f4cf72
    }

    .level-ring small {
      color: #999;
      margin-top: 3px
    }

    .level-meta {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 28px;
      border-top: 1px solid #2b2c31;
      padding-top: 12px;
      color: #e7e7e7
    }

    .level-meta span {
      font-weight: 700
    }

    .level-meta small {
      display: block;
      color: #777;
      font-size: .63rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      margin-top: 2px
    }

    .topic-list {
      margin-top: 16px
    }

    .topic-line {
      margin: 0 0 11px
    }

    .topic-line>div:first-child {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      font-size: .68rem;
      margin-bottom: 5px
    }

    .topic-line b {
      color: #ddd;
      font-size: .65rem
    }

    .topic-track {
      height: 5px;
      background: #25262a;
      border-radius: 99px;
      overflow: hidden
    }

    .topic-track i {
      display: block;
      height: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #e4b84f, #f6d27a);
      border-radius: 99px
    }

    .mini-link {
      width: 100%;
      background: none;
      color: #eee;
      border: 0;
      border-top: 1px solid #2b2c31;
      border-radius: 0;
      padding: 12px 0 0;
      text-align: left;
      font-size: .7rem
    }

    .mini-link:hover {
      background: none;
      color: #e4b84f
    }

    .performance-score {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: center;
      margin: 17px 0 13px
    }

    .target-icon {
      font-size: 2.2rem;
      color: #ff5a16
    }

    .performance-score small,

    }

    .mode-switch {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      background: #202020;
      padding: 4px;
      border-radius: 10px
    }

    .mode-switch button {
      border: 0;
      background: transparent;
      color: #ddd;
      padding: 9px 14px;
      border-radius: 7px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-weight: 700
    }

    .mode-switch button.active {
      background: #d2a52e;
      color: #111
    }

    .viewer-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #333
    }

    .three-plane-mode {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 12px
    }

    .three-plane-mode.hidden,
    .brain-section-mode.hidden {
      display: none !important
    }

    .mri-panel {
      background: #080808;
      border: 1px solid #333;
      border-radius: 10px;
      overflow: hidden;
      min-width: 0
    }

    .mri-panel.active {
      border-color: #d2a52e;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #d2a52e44
    }

    .mri-panel-head {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 9px 12px;
      background: #191919;
      font-size: 14px
    }

    .mri-canvas-wrap,
    .single-canvas-wrap {
      position: relative;
      background: #000;
      min-height: 430px;
      overflow: hidden;
      touch-action: none
    }

    .mri-canvas-wrap canvas,
    .single-canvas-wrap canvas {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: 430px
    }

    .ori {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 13px;
      text-shadow: 0 1px 3px #000
    }

    .ori span {
      position: absolute
    }

    .ori .top {
      top: 8px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%)
    }

    .ori .bottom {
      bottom: 8px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%)
    }

    .ori .left {
      left: 8px;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%)
    }

    .ori .right {
      right: 8px;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%)
    }

    .crosshair-v,
    .crosshair-h,
    .single-cross-v,
    .single-cross-h {
      position: absolute;
      background: #21e6d6;
      box-shadow: 0 0 5px #000;
      pointer-events: none
    }

    .crosshair-v {
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      width: 1px;
      transform: translateX(-50%)
    }

    .crosshair-h {
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 1px;
      transform: translateY(-50%)
    }

    .crosshair-dot {
      position: absolute;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 16px;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      pointer-events: none;
      text-shadow: 0 0 5px #000
    }

    .panel-range,
    .single-view-shell input[type=range] {
      width: calc(100% - 24px);
      margin: 9px 12px;
      accent-color: #d2a52e
    }

    .panel-controls {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 8px
    }

    .sync-footer {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      background: #191919;
      border-top: 1px solid #333
    }

    .sync-footer>div {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px
    }

    .sync-footer span {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #aaa
    }

    .anatomy-list-wrap {
      margin: 0 12px 14px;
      border: 1px solid #333;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 10px;
      background: #171717
    }

    .single-view-shell {
      padding: 12px
    }

    .single-head {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 8px
    }

    .viewer-plane-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 4px
    }

    .viewer-plane-tabs button {
      background: #262626;
      border: 1px solid #444;
      color: #ddd;
      padding: 7px 12px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      cursor: pointer
    }

    .viewer-plane-tabs button.active {
      background: #d2a52e;
      color: #111
    }

    .single-canvas-wrap {
      min-height: 600px
    }

    .single-canvas-wrap canvas {
      height: 600px
    }

    .single-cross-v {
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      width: 1px;
      background: #21e6d6;
      transform: translateX(-50%)
    }

    .single-cross-h {
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 1px;
      background: #21e6d6;
      transform: translateY(-50%)
    }

    @media(max-width:1100px) {
      .three-plane-mode {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr
      }

      .sync-footer {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr
      }

      .mri-canvas-wrap canvas {
        height: 520px
      }
    }

    /* ===== Zoom / Capture / Anatomical label overlay (added) ===== */
    .zoom-controls {
      display: flex;
      gap: 4px;
      align-items: center
    }

    .zoom-controls button {
      width: 34px;
      padding: 7px 0;
      font-weight: 800
    }

    .label-toggle-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 7px;
      font-size: .72rem;
      color: #ddd;
      cursor: pointer;
      user-select: none;
      padding: 0 4px
    }

    .switch {
      width: 28px;
      height: 14px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: #555;
      position: relative;
      cursor: pointer;
      flex: none;
      display: inline-block
    }

    .switch:after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      top: 2px;
      left: 2px;
      background: #fff;
      border-radius: 50%;
      transition: .15s
    }

    .switch.on {
      background: #4bd5df
    }

    .switch.on:after {
      left: 16px
    }

    .overlay-marker {
      position: absolute;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      pointer-events: auto;
      cursor: pointer;
      z-index: 6
    }

    .overlay-marker .marker-dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--mc, #ffd15a);
      border: 1.5px solid #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 0 5px var(--mc, #ffd15a);
      animation: markerPulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
      flex: none
    }

    .overlay-marker .marker-tag {
      background: rgba(8, 9, 13, .9);
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 3px 7px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .18);
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateX(-4px);
      transition: opacity .15s, transform .15s
    }

    .overlay-marker:hover .marker-tag {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateX(0)
    }

    @keyframes markerPulse {

      0%,
      100% {
        box-shadow: 0 0 4px var(--mc, #ffd15a)
      }

      50% {
        box-shadow: 0 0 13px var(--mc, #ffd15a)
      }
    }

    .section-labels {
      background: #111217;
      border: 1px solid #2d2f35;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 12px;
      max-height: 700px;
      overflow: auto
    }

    .section-labels h4 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      font-size: .65rem;
      color: #bbb;
      letter-spacing: .06em
    }

    .section-label-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 9px 4px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #23242b;
      cursor: pointer;
      opacity: .5;
      transition: opacity .15s, background .15s
    }

    .section-label-row.visible {
      opacity: 1
    }

    .section-label-row:hover {
      background: #1a1b20
    }

    .section-label-row b {
      display: block;
      font-size: .74rem;
      color: #fff
    }

    .section-label-row p {
      margin: 3px 0 0;
      font-size: .65rem;
      color: #9a9ba3;
      line-height: 1.45
    }

    .section-label-row .color-dot {
      width: 9px;
      height: 9px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      flex: none;
      margin-top: 4px;
      box-shadow: 0 0 6px currentColor
    }

    .viewer-label-row.selected {
      background: #182a2c
    }

    .viewer-label-row .eye {
      color: #4bd5df
    }

    .section-learning-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 155px minmax(0, 1fr) 250px;
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: stretch
    }

    .section-crossrefs {
      background: #101114;
      border: 1px solid #2d2f35;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 8px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px
    }

    .section-ref-card {
      background: #07080b;
      border: 1px solid #2b2d33;
      border-radius: 7px;
      padding: 5px;
      cursor: pointer;
      position: relative
    }

    .section-ref-card:hover,
    .section-ref-card.active {
      border-color: #d2a52e;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #d2a52e55
    }

    .section-ref-title {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #ddd;
      margin: 0 0 4px
    }

    .section-ref-wrap {
      position: relative;
      aspect-ratio: 1.12/1;
      background: #000;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: 5px
    }

    .section-ref-wrap canvas {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: block
    }

    .section-ref-line {
      position: absolute;
      background: #f0c94a;
      box-shadow: 0 0 3px #000;
      pointer-events: none
    }

    .section-ref-line.v {
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      width: 2px;
      transform: translateX(-50%)
    }

    .section-ref-line.h {
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 2px;
      transform: translateY(-50%)
    }

    .section-ref-meta {
      font-size: 9px;
      color: #999;
      margin-top: 4px;
      text-align: center
    }

    .section-ref-note {
      font-size: 9px;
      line-height: 1.4;
      color: #777;
      padding: 2px 3px
    }

    .section-main-area {
      min-width: 0
    }

    .section-main-area .single-view-shell {
      padding: 0
    }

    .section-main-area .single-canvas-wrap {
      min-height: 620px
    }

    .section-main-area .single-canvas-wrap canvas {
      height: 620px
    }

    .section-location-bar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: center;
      background: #17181c;
      border: 1px solid #2c2e34;
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 8px 10px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #bbb
    }

    .section-location-bar strong {
      color: #f0c94a
    }

    @media(max-width:900px) {
      .section-learning-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr
      }

      .section-crossrefs {
        flex-direction: row;
        overflow: auto
      }

      .section-ref-card {
        min-width: 150px
      }

      .section-labels {
        max-height: 260px
      }

      .section-main-area .single-canvas-wrap,
      .section-main-area .single-canvas-wrap canvas {
        min-height: 500px;
        height: 500px
      }
    }

    .brand-logo {
      min-width: 176px;
      height: 42px
    }

    .brand-logo .brand-image {
      width: 176px;
      height: auto;
      max-height: 42px;
      image-rendering: auto
    }

    @media(max-width:650px) {
      .brand-logo {
        min-width: 132px;
        height: 32px
      }

      .brand-logo .brand-image {
        width: 132px;
        max-height: 32px
      }
    }
  </style>

  <style id="brtomox-ui">
    :root {
      --bo: #f0892b;
      --by: #f6d04d
    }

    body {
      font-family: "Poppins", "Segoe UI", "Chulabhorn Likit Text Light", sans-serif
    }

    .navbar {

    .lang-toggle button.active {

    .lang-toggle button:hover {

    #auth-area {

    }

    .bm-home {
      padding: 28px 34px
    }

    .bm-welcome {

      margin: 0 0 14px
    }

    .bm-hist {

      margin-bottom: 10px
    }

    .bm-chips {

    }

    .bm-chip {

      background: #333336;

      padding: 9px 26px 9px 10px;

    }

    .bm-chip i {

    }

    .bm-chip:hover {
      background: #444;

    }

    .bm-mode {
      font-size: 1.45rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      margin: 26px 0 14px
    }

    .bm-cards {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 260px));
      gap: 34px;
      justify-content: center
    }

    .bm-card {
      background: #000;
      border: 3px solid #fff;
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 6px;
      color: #fff;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px
    }

    .bm-card:hover {
      background: #111;
      border-color: var(--by);
      color: #fff
    }

    .bm-card span {
      font-size: .9rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding-bottom: 4px
    }

    @media(max-width:760px) {
      .bm-cards {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr
      }

      .navbar {
        flex-wrap: wrap
      }

      .nv-search {
        display: none
      }
    }

    /* ---- login gate ---- */
    #bm-gate {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: #000;
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow: auto
    }

    body.bm-locked #bm-gate {
      display: flex
    }

    body.bm-locked>header,
    body.bm-locked>main {
      visibility: hidden
    }

    .gt-bar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      background: #232325;
      padding: 10px 20px
    }

    .gt-bar img {
      height: 34px
    }

    .gt-bar nav {
      display: flex;
      gap: 18px;
      color: #bbb;
      font-size: .78rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      flex: 1;
      justify-content: center
    }

    .gt-body {
      flex: 1;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1px 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 30px
    }

    .gt-left {
      text-align: center;
      min-width: 0;
      outline: 0
    }

    .gt-view {
      overflow: hidden;
      touch-action: pan-y;
      cursor: grab;
      user-select: none
    }

    .gt-view.drag {
      cursor: grabbing
    }

    .gt-track {
      display: flex;
      transition: transform .55s cubic-bezier(.22, .8, .3, 1)
    }

    .gt-track.nt {
      transition: none
    }

    .gt-slide {
      flex: 0 0 100%;
      margin: 0;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center
    }

    .gt-title {
      width: min(340px, 78%);
      height: auto;
      overflow: visible;
      margin-bottom: -6px
    }

    .gt-title text {
      font: 800 50px "Fredoka", "Baloo 2", "Nunito", "Arial Rounded MT Bold", ui-rounded, "Poppins", sans-serif;
      fill: #fff;
      letter-spacing: 1px
    }

    .gt-slide img {
      height: min(46vh, 400px);
      max-width: 86%;
      width: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      display: block;
      background: #000;
      -webkit-user-drag: none;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .gt-slide img[data-k=co] {
      -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(#000 88%, transparent);
      mask-image: linear-gradient(#000 88%, transparent)
    }

    .gt-slide img:not([src]) {
      visibility: hidden
    }

    .gt-dots {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-top: 18px
    }

    .gt-dot {
      width: 13px;
      height: 13px;
      padding: 0;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #fff;
      opacity: .4;
      border: 0;
      transition: opacity .25s, transform .25s
    }

    .gt-dot:hover {
      background: #fff;
      opacity: .8
    }

    .gt-dot[aria-current=true] {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: scale(1.25);
      background: var(--by)
    }

    .gt-left:focus-visible .gt-view,
    .gt-dot:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--by);
      outline-offset: 3px
    }

    @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {
      .gt-track {
        transition: none
      }
    }

    .gt-line {
      background: #555;
      align-self: stretch
    }

    .gt-right {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 10px
    }

    .gt-card {
      width: min(400px, 100%);
      background: #171821;
      border: 2px solid #5b4bd8;
      border-radius: 22px;
      padding: 34px 20px 22px;
      box-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(109, 74, 255, .35)
    }

    .gt-card>img {
      display: block;
      height: 48px;
      margin: 0 auto 24px
    }

    .gt-f {
      position: relative;
      border: 1px solid #777;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 6px 12px 2px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      background: #1a1b24
    }

    .gt-f label {
      font-size: .62rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
      display: block
    }

    .gt-f input {
      border: 0;
      background: transparent;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 4px 0 8px;
      outline: 0;
      color: #fff
    }

    .gt-f button {
      position: absolute;
      right: 8px;
      top: 12px;
      background: none;
      color: #fff;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      font-size: 1.1rem
    }

    .gt-go {
      width: 100%;
      background: #c26100;

    }

    .gt-go:hover {

    }

    .gt-lnk {
      display: block;
      background: none;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: .68rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin: 0 auto 14px;
      padding: 2px
    }

    .gt-lnk:hover {
      background: none;
      color: var(--by)
    }

    .gt-alt {
      width: 100%;

    }

    }

    .gt-msg {

    @media(max-width:760px) {

      }

      .gt-line {
        display: none
      }

      .gt-left {
        display: none
      }

      .gt-bar nav {
        display: none
      }
    }
  </style>
  <style id="v22">

    .bm-wrow {

    }

    }

    #pf {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 200;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .7);
      display: grid;
      place-items: center
    }

    .pf-box {
      width: min(400px, 92vw);
      background: #171821;
      border: 2px solid #5b4bd8;
      border-radius: 22px;
      padding: 24px
    }

    .pf-box h3 {
      margin: 0 0 14px
    }

    .pf-av {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 12px
    }

    .sx {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 165px minmax(0, 1fr) 210px;
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 14px;
      align-items: start
    }

    .sx-prof {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: center;
      background: #15161d;
      border: 1px solid #2a2b34;
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 10px
    }

    .sx-prof small {
      display: block;
      color: #999;
      font-size: .65rem
    }

    .sx-t {
      margin: 0 0 8px;
      font-size: 1.3rem
    }

    .sx-l .section-crossrefs {
      background: none;
      border: 0;
      padding: 0
    }

    .sx-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 170px;
      gap: 10px
    }

    .sx .single-canvas-wrap {
      min-height: 520px;
      position: relative;
      background: #000;
      border-radius: 12px;
      overflow: hidden
    }

    .sx .single-canvas-wrap canvas {
      height: 520px;
      width: 100%
    }

    .sx-pills {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px
    }

    .sx-pills .section-label-row {
      border: 2px solid var(--c, #fff);
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 5px 10px;
      background: #0b0c11;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px
    }

    .sx-pills .section-label-row p {
      display: none
    }

    .sx-pills .section-label-row b {
      font-size: .68rem
    }

    .sx-pills .section-label-row.sel {
      background: #6b5a1c
    }

    .sx-pills .section-label-row .color-dot {
      margin: 0
    }

      margin-top: 10px;
      background: #d9a621;
      color: #2a1c00;
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 12px 16px
    }

    .sx-def h3 {
      margin: 0 0 4px;
      color: #b50d0d;
      font-size: 1.05rem
    }

    .sx-def p {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: .8rem
    }

    .sx-r {
      background: #1f1f22;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 10px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px
    }

    .sx-acc {
      border: 1px solid #ddd;
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 5px 12px;
      font-size: .72rem;
      font-weight: 700
    }

    .sx-sw {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: .72rem;
      cursor: pointer
    }

    .sx-b {
      font-size: .74rem;
      text-align: left
    }

    .sx-tf {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px
    }

    .sx-tf button {
      padding: 6px 9px
    }

    .sx.no-color .sx-pills .section-label-row {
      border-color: #666
    }

    .sx.no-dir .ori {
      display: none
    }

    .sx.no-def .sx-def {

    }

      font-size: .74rem

    .ref-window.lab-room {

    }

      color: #cfcfd6
    }

    .lr-st {

      gap: 22px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 10px 22px
    }

    .lr-n {
      font-size: 1.7rem;
      color: #f4cf2a
    }

    .lr-n i {
      font-size: 1rem;
      color: #fff;
      font-style: normal
    }

    .lr-clock {

      gap: 10px;

    }

    .lr-clock span {
      font-size: 1.8rem;
      color: #f4cf2a
    }

    .lr-clock b {
      font-size: 1.7rem
    }

    .lr-exit {

    }

    .lr-mid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 250px;

    }

    .lr-img {

      background: rgba(10, 10, 12, .75)
    }

    }

    .lr-gold {

      font-weight: 800
    }

    .lr-no {
      display: block;
      color: #f4cf2a;
      font-size: 1.3rem;

    }

    .lr-q p {

      font-size: .9rem
    }

    .lr-q .exam-mcq-grid {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr
    }

    .lr-sub {
      width: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(#f39a12, #d97f06);

    }

    .lr-strip {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0;
      justify-content: center;
      max-width: 620px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 6px 10px
    }

    .lr-strip span {
      flex: 1;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: .8rem;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      color: #ddd
    }

    .lr-strip span.cur {
      background: rgba(75, 60, 220, .35);
      border-radius: 8px
    }

    .lr-strip em {
      display: block;
      font-style: normal;
      font-size: .8rem
    }

    @media(max-width:760px) {
      .lr-mid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr
      }
    }

  <style id="v23">
    html {
      font-size: calc(16px*var(--fs, 1))
    }

    body,
    button,

    }

    .viewer-actions .zoom-controls button {

      padding: 7px 10px
    }

    .viewer-actions .zoom-controls {

    }

    .viewer-actions .zoom-controls .control-btn {
      padding: 7px 10px
    }

    #zoom-level {

    .viewer-main > div:nth-child(2),

    .single-canvas-wrap {
      overflow: hidden !important;
      position: relative
    }

    .mode-pan {
      cursor: grab !important
    }

    .mode-pan:active {
      cursor: grabbing !important
    }

    .mode-zoom {
      cursor: zoom-in !important
    }

    .anatomy-list-wrap {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(250px, 1fr));
      gap: 0 18px
    }

    .anatomy-list-wrap>.muted {

    }

    .overlay-marker {
      display: block;
      width: 0;
      height: 0
    }

    .overlay-marker .marker-dot {
      position: absolute;
      left: -4px;
      top: -4px
    }

    .overlay-marker .marker-tag {
      position: absolute;
      left: 12px;
      top: 0;
      transform: translateY(-50%)
    }

    .overlay-marker:hover .marker-tag {
      transform: translateY(-50%)
    }

    .overlay-marker {

    .card .muted {

    }

        vw.onpointerup = up; vw.onpointercancel = up;
        car.onmouseenter = stop; car.onmouseleave = play;
        const fill = () => { if (!window.BRslice) return; car.querySelectorAll('img[data-k]').forEach(im => { if (!im.src) im.src = window.BRslice(im.dataset.k) }) };
        document.addEventListener('br-ready', () => { fill(); play() }); fill(); show(0); if (window.BRslice) play()
      })();
      function form(m) {
        const f = $('#gt-form');
        if (m === 'in') {
          f.innerHTML = `<div class="gt-f"><label>Student ID (6xxxxxx)</label><input id="g-id" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="username"></div><div class="gt-f"><label>Password</label><input id="g-pw" type="password" autocomplete="current-password"><button type="button" id="g-eye" title="Show password">👁</button></div><div class="gt-msg" id="g-m"></div><button class="gt-go" id="g-go">Log in</button><button class="gt-lnk" id="g-fp">Forget your password?</button><button class="gt-alt" id="g-new">Create a new account</button><button class="gt-alt" id="g-ms" style="margin-top:8px">▦ Sign in with Microsoft</button>`;
          $('#g-eye').onclick = () => { const p = $('#g-pw'); p.type = p.type === 'password' ? 'text' : 'password' };
          const go = async () => {
            const id = $('#g-id').value.trim(), u = users()[id], m = $('#g-m'); m.className = 'gt-msg';
            if (!/^6\d{6}$/.test(id)) { m.textContent = 'Student ID must be 7 digits starting with 6.'; return }
            if (!u || u.pw !== await H($('#g-pw').value)) { m.textContent = 'Student ID or password is incorrect.'; return }
            enter({ id, name: u.name, role: u.role, email: u.email, avatar: u.avatar })
          };
          $('#g-go').onclick = go; f.onkeydown = e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') go() };
          $('#g-fp').onclick = () => { const m = $('#g-m'); m.className = 'gt-msg ok'; m.textContent = 'Please contact your instructor to reset your password.' };
          $('#g-new').onclick = () => form('up'); $('#g-ms').onclick = msLogin
        }
        else {
          f.innerHTML = `<div class="gt-f"><label>Full name (e.g. SITTHINON C.)</label><input id="s-nm"></div><div class="gt-f"><label>Student ID (6xxxxxx)</label><input id="s-id" inputmode="numeric"></div><div class="gt-f"><label>Password (min. 6 characters)</label><input id="s-pw" type="password"><button type="button" id="s-eye">👁</button></div><div class="gt-msg" id="s-m"></div><button class="gt-go" id="s-go">Create account</button><button class="gt-alt" id="s-back">Back to log in</button>`;
          $('#s-eye').onclick = () => { const p = $('#s-pw'); p.type = p.type === 'password' ? 'text' : 'password' };
          $('#s-back').onclick = () => form('in');
          $('#s-go').onclick = async () => {
            const nm = $('#s-nm').value.trim(), id = $('#s-id').value.trim(), pw = $('#s-pw').value, m = $('#s-m'), u = users(); m.className = 'gt-msg';
            if (nm.length < 2) { m.textContent = 'Enter your name.'; return }
            if (!/^6\d{6}$/.test(id)) { m.textContent = 'Student ID must be 7 digits starting with 6.'; return }
            if (pw.length < 6) { m.textContent = 'Password needs at least 6 characters.'; return }
            if (u[id]) { m.textContent = 'This Student ID already has an account.'; return }
            u[id] = { name: nm, pw: await H(pw) }; wr('br_users', JSON.stringify(u)); enter({ id, name: nm })
          }
        }
      }
      let ss = null; try { ss = JSON.parse(rd('br_session') || 'null') } catch (e) { }
      if (ss && ss.id && users()[ss.id]) { window.BR_USER = ss; nav() } else { B.classList.add('bm-locked'); nav(); form('in') }
    })();
  </script>
  <script id="v23js">
    (function () {
      const $ = s => document.querySelector(s), en = () => { const b = $('[data-lang].active'); return !!b && b.dataset.lang === 'en' };
      const close = () => { const o = $('#v23o'); o && o.remove() };
      function open(h) { close(); const o = document.createElement('div'); o.id = 'v23o'; o.innerHTML = '<div class="v23p">' + h + '</div>'; o.onclick = e => { if (e.target === o) close() }; document.body.append(o); return o }
      document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Escape') close() });
      const go = v => { const a = $('#nav-menu a[data-view="' + v + '"]'); close(); a && a.click() };
      window.BRset = () => {
        const E = (a, b) => en() ? b : a, { S, ap } = window.BRS, ch = (k, v, l) => `<span class="choice-chip ${S[k] == v ? 'active' : ''}" data-k="${k}" data-v="${v}">${l}</span>`;
        const draw = () => {
          const o = open(`<h3>⚙ ${E('การตั้งค่า', 'Settings')}</h3><p class="muted">${E('โหมดสี', 'Theme')}</p><div class="choice-group">${ch('theme', 'dark', E('มืด', 'Dark'))}${ch('theme', 'light', E('สว่าง', 'Light'))}${ch('theme', 'two', E('ทูโทน (แถบบนมืด / เนื้อหาสว่าง)', 'Two-tone (dark bar / light content)'))}</div>
<p class="muted">${E('ฟอนต์', 'Font')}</p><div class="choice-group">${ch('font', 'sys', E('ระบบ (ค่าเริ่มต้น)', 'System'))}${ch('font', 'sarabun', 'Sarabun')}${ch('font', 'prompt', 'Prompt')}${ch('font', 'noto', 'Noto Sans Thai')}</div>
<p class="muted">${E('ขนาดตัวอักษร', 'Font size')}</p><div class="choice-group">${[.9, 1, 1.15, 1.3].map(v => ch('size', v, Math.round(v * 100) + '%')).join('')}</div>
<button class="secondary" id="v23r" style="margin-top:18px">${E('คืนค่าเริ่มต้น', 'Reset')}</button>`);
          o.querySelectorAll('[data-k]').forEach(c => c.onclick = () => { const v = c.dataset.v; S[c.dataset.k] = isNaN(+v) ? v : +v; ap(); draw() });
          $('#v23r').onclick = () => { Object.assign(S, window.BRS.D); ap(); draw() }
        }; draw()
      };
      window.BRmenu = out => {
        const E = (a, b) => en() ? b : a, M = [['dashboard', '🏠', E('หน้าแรก', 'Home'), ['progress', 'mriviewer']], ['mriviewer', '🧠', E('ภาคตัดขวาง (Section Anatomy)', 'Section Anatomy'), ['flashcards', 'quiz']], ['flashcards', '🃏', 'Flashcard', ['mriviewer', 'quiz']], ['quiz', '❓', 'Quiz Mode', ['flashcards', 'labexam']], ['labexam', '🧪', 'Lab Practice', ['quiz', 'progress']], ['progress', '📈', E('ความก้าวหน้า (Progress)', 'Progress'), ['quiz', 'labexam']], ['contact', '✉', E('ติดต่อ', 'Contact'), ['dashboard']]], N = Object.fromEntries(M.map(m => [m[0], m[1] + ' ' + m[2]]));
        const o = open(`<h3>☰ ${E('เมนู', 'Menu')}</h3>` + M.map(m => `<div class="v23i"><button class="v23m" data-v="${m[0]}">${m[1]} ${m[2]}</button><div class="v23rel"><small>${E('ที่เกี่ยวข้อง', 'Related')}:</small>${m[3].map(r => `<a data-v="${r}">${N[r]}</a>`).join('')}</div></div>`).join('') + `<button class="secondary" id="v23lo" style="margin-top:16px;width:100%">${E('ออกจากระบบ', 'Log out')}</button>`);
        o.querySelectorAll('[data-v]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => go(b.dataset.v)); $('#v23lo').onclick = () => { close(); out() }
      };
    })();
  </script>
  <style id="anatomy-leader-layout">
    .real-mri-viewer .sx{grid-template-columns:120px minmax(0,1fr) 240px;gap:12px}
    .real-mri-viewer .sx-c{min-width:0}

    .real-mri-viewer .mk{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:3}

    .real-mri-viewer .leader-label:hover,.real-mri-viewer .leader-label:focus-visible{background:#152c39;outline:1px solid #83e5f1;outline-offset:1px}
    .real-mri-viewer .sx-r{background:#1d2026;border:1px solid #343942;border-radius:8px;min-width:0}
    .anatomy-menu{background:#1d2026;border:1px solid #343942;border-radius:8px;color:#f1f5f9;padding:14px;min-width:0}

    .anatomy-menu h3{font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;margin:0 0 14px;color:#fff}
    .anatomy-toggle-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;min-height:46px;margin:0;border-bottom:1px solid #30353c;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer}
    .anatomy-toggle-row small{color:#a9b4c2;margin-left:4px}

    .anatomy-menu .category-toggle:checked,.anatomy-menu .category-toggle:indeterminate{background:#007bff}
    .category-toggle::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;width:16px;height:16px;background:#fff;border-radius:50%;transition:transform .2s}
    .category-toggle:checked::after{transform:translateX(18px)}
    .category-toggle:indeterminate::after{transform:translateX(9px)}
    .category-toggle:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #83e5f1;outline-offset:4px}
    .anatomy-note,.anatomy-count{font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;color:#aab5c4;margin:14px 0 0}
    .anatomy-count{color:#83e5f1}
    .real-mri-viewer .anatomy-jump-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:6px;margin-top:12px}
    .anatomy-viewer-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 240px;gap:12px;align-items:start}
    .anatomy-viewer-layout .three-plane-mode{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:0}
    @media(min-width:1600px){.anatomy-viewer-layout .three-plane-mode{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}}
    @media(max-width:1000px){.real-mri-viewer .sx{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 230px}.real-mri-viewer .sx-l{grid-column:1/-1;display:none}}
    @media(max-width:700px){.real-mri-viewer .sx,.anatomy-viewer-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.real-mri-viewer .sx-r{grid-column:1}.real-mri-viewer .leader-label{font-size:9px}.real-mri-viewer .single-canvas-wrap,.real-mri-viewer .single-canvas-wrap canvas{height:460px;min-height:460px}.anatomy-menu .category-toggle{min-height:22px}.anatomy-toggle-row{min-height:48px}}
    @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.category-toggle,.category-toggle::after{transition:none}}
    @media(max-width:1100px){.navbar{flex-wrap:wrap;max-width:100%}.navbar #nav-menu{order:3;flex:0 0 100%;justify-content:flex-start;overflow-x:auto;min-width:0}.navbar #nav-menu a{flex-shrink:0}.navbar>div:last-child{margin-left:auto}}
  </style>
  <style id="horizontal-anatomy-labels">
    /* One shared Y coordinate keeps the text, leader and dot aligned. */
    .mri-overlay { position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:5; }
    .mri-overlay .anatomy-label { position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; }
    .mri-overlay .anatomy-label .label-line {
      position:absolute; top:var(--label-y); left:var(--line-x);
      width:var(--line-width); height:1.5px;
      background:var(--label-color,#21e6d6);
      box-shadow:0 0 3px var(--label-color,#21e6d6);
      transform:translateY(-50%); transform-origin:left center;
    }
    .mri-overlay .anatomy-label .label-dot {
      position:absolute; top:var(--label-y); left:var(--dot-x);
      width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%;
      background:var(--label-color,#21e6d6);
      border:1px solid var(--label-color,#21e6d6);
      box-shadow:0 0 5px var(--label-color,#21e6d6);
      transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
    }
    .mri-overlay .anatomy-label .label-text {
      position:absolute; top:var(--label-y); width:var(--label-width,25%);
      min-height:0; margin:0; padding:3px 4px; border:0; border-radius:3px;
      background:rgba(5,9,14,.88); color:var(--label-color,#21e6d6);
      font-size:.75rem; font-weight:600; line-height:1.3;
      white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;
      text-shadow:0 1px 4px #000; transform:translateY(-50%);
      pointer-events:auto; cursor:pointer;
    }
    .mri-overlay .label-left .label-text { left:var(--label-pad,8px); text-align:left; }
    .mri-overlay .label-right .label-text { right:var(--label-pad,8px); text-align:right; }
    .mri-overlay .label-text:hover,.mri-overlay .label-text:focus-visible {
      outline:1px solid var(--label-color); outline-offset:1px;
    }
  </style>

  <style id="strict-three-plane-layout">
    /* Keep all MRI planes in one horizontal row at every viewport width. */
